title: Beasts of Aethelgard – Great Herds
content: The Great Herds of the Wandering Reaches deserve special mention because they are not simply beasts, but ecosystems in motion. Vast herds of six-legged herbivores called thunderbeasts migrate across the grasslands in numbers that eclipse the horizon, their footsteps audible for miles. They are not aggressive, but they are unstoppable; a thunderbeast herd will simply roll through anything in its path. Halfling Kith have learned to read their movements the way farmers read the weather, planning their own migrations to avoid or accompany the herds as circumstances dictate. Alongside the thunderbeasts are packs of predators—direwolves, great cats, and stranger things—that cull the weak and old; scavengers follow, scavenging the remains. The entire ecosystem moves together, a living tide of flesh and hunger crossing the Reach since the first halfling built a landship.
